newsitem.title: USA: Small fire doused at Tosco Calif. refinery.
newsitem.headline: Small fire doused at Tosco Calif. refinery.

text.p: A small fire overnight at Tosco Corp's 104,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Rodeo, Calif., was extinguished without disrupting operations, a union official said Wednesday.
The refinery, east of San Francisco, was recently purchased from Unocal Corp along with the company's other downstream assets.
"They had a little fire in their sulfur pit," which was quickly put out, said the official, who declined to be identified.
News of the fire was first reported by a San Francisco radio station, which said no injuries resulted from the flare up.
The pit stores sulfur for later use in petrochemicals, the official said.
